items.summary: Retain the existing readiness and repair gates, but reject any financial interpretation of vanity metrics. Search performance totals of 14,560 impressions, 149 clicks, 1,010 sessions, and 15 conversions do not establish revenue or profitability; the existing 7-session affiliate comparison with unchanged 1 conversion before and after is inconclusive. Continue measurement only with available telemetry and report revenue, attribution, cost, and causal-lift fields as unknown where unavailable.
